liveSession.confirmLeaveLogonTitle: The remote computer will stay signed in
liveSession.confirmLeaveLogonBody: If you disconnect without logging off, the remote computer stays signed in. Anyone at that screen can keep working as the signed-in account. Your console sign-in here is not affected.
liveSession.confirmLogoffBlockedBody: This product cannot sign the remote computer off for this connection yet. There is no logoff path. You can disconnect only — the remote computer stays signed in. Your console sign-in here is not affected.
liveSession.confirmLogoffAttemptBody: This will try to sign the remote computer off, then close this view. Sign-off is not guaranteed. Your console sign-in here is not affected.
liveSession.confirmDisconnectStay: Disconnect ends the live channel for every participant and returns you to the page you connected from.
liveSession.confirmLeaveOtTitle: The remote device may keep running
liveSession.confirmLeaveOtBody: If you disconnect without a logoff, the remote device or process may keep running. This product cannot sign an OT device off. Your console sign-in here is not affected.
liveSession.endPolicyWhyAsk: Disconnect closes this view. The remote computer may stay signed in. Log off tries to end that sign-in, then closes this view. Privileged connections default to Log off. Your console sign-in here is not affected.
liveSession.noLiveSessionId: No live session id — use Open session (Connection points) or Connect (My Workstations) before connecting. The zero UUID is not a valid session.
liveSession.panHelpDrag: Drag to pan. Arrow keys pan; +/− zoom; 0 fits. Ctrl+wheel zooms.
liveSession.panHelpKeys: Arrow keys pan; +/− zoom; 0 fits. Ctrl+wheel zooms. Space is reserved for remote input.
liveSession.exitChordSet: Exit full screen key set to {{chord}}
liveSession.sshViewportAria: SSH terminal font size and full screen
liveSession.policyReadonlyHint: Clipboard and file copy follow the policy set for you and this computer.
liveSession.waitingSupervisorYou: Waiting for you to join. The operator cannot type until you join.
liveSession.waitingSupervisorOp: Waiting for a supervisor. You cannot type until they join.
liveSession.rdpBlankDesktop: Connected — the remote desktop is still black. Press Ctrl+Alt+Del or click the screen and press a key.
liveSession.vncWaitingFrames: Connected — waiting for the remote desktop to appear.
liveSession.fileTransferHint: Send copies the file to the remote computer. SSH uses SFTP into aic-transfer in the account home. Windows Remote Desktop uses the user profile aic-transfer folder.
liveSession.uploadFile: Send file to the remote computer
